annotations.title: Watch one red-list entry for changes

description: Polling this register every morning to see whether a firm is still on a red list? Watch the listing instead. Give the record id and this hands back one URL that answers "has it changed" in a single conditional request: 304 if nothing we hold about that listing has moved, 200 with the change and FDA's own sentence if it has. Same feed as Atom for a feed reader. This register records a before and after for each change, so the feed can say what it used to say. We do not push and store nothing about you — the URL is derived from the record id, so this makes your poll cheap and definite rather than notifying you.

record_id.description: The listing's record id, from resolve_firm or list_alert_firms.

name: watch

current.description: What the register holds for this record right now, with its citation.

change_history.description: True where this dataset records a before and after for each change. False means the feed can still tell you THAT the record moved, by its ETag, but not what it used to say.

feed_url.description: GET this for the record's current state and change list.

feed_url_atom.description: The same thing as Atom, for a feed reader.
